findings.evidence: Row sets version_status="published" and version="40-tasks". Per criterion c2, "published" requires the maintainer to publish a release identifier for this board that the version copies. SOURCE 3 README and SOURCE 1 page contain no benchmark release identifier; the only version-like strings are agent versions (EvoScientist v0.1.1/v0.0.4, InnoClaw (2.0)), and the badge "Tasks-40" is a count, not a release identifier. Therefore the protocol publishes no release identifier for this board, so version_status should be "snapshot" (with a snapshot-<date> version if no release id exists) rather than "published".
findings.repair: Set version_status to "snapshot" and version to snapshot-<freeze date> unless a published release identifier for the board can be cited; alternatively supply evidence of a maintainer-published release identifier if "published" is to be retained.
